utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Hi Meera, this is Arjun from Acme finance. Priya is joining in a minute.
Hi Arjun, thanks for making the time. Shall we start with where things stand on your side?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Sure. For this phase our budget is twenty five lakh, that's what has been sanctioned.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Hi everyone, sorry I'm late. This is Priya.
No problem Priya. Quick check, do you need the data hosted in a specific region?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Yes, like I said on Monday, it has to be the EU region.
Got it. On timelines, we can definitely have you live in four weeks.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: That would be great, because we really need it soon.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Honestly, my worry is that our IT team is already overloaded with the SAP upgrade.
Our SAP connector does most of the heavy lifting there.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Okay. It also has to work with our legacy billing system.
We support most billing systems out of the box through our API.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: What does support look like after go-live?
Let me first walk you through the architecture.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Sure. I'll send you our current integration list.
Perfect. On security, what will your team need from us?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Our infosec team will need the ISO 27001 certificate and a recent penetration test report.
We are ISO 27001 certified. I'll share the certificate by Monday.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Good. We should come back to the data migration question later.
Sure, let's park that for now.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I think that's all from me. Anything else?
Thanks both. I'll follow up with the certificate and a pilot proposal.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Thanks Meera, talk soon.
